sn2.12:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Veṇḍu devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.12:2.1: Sukhitā va te manujā || Sugataṃ payirūpāsiya || yuñja Gotamasāsane || appamattānusikkhare ti || ||
sn2.12:3.1: Ye me pavutte satthipade || (Veṇḍūti Bhagavā) anusikkhanti jhāyino || kāle te appamajjantā || na maccuvasaṅgā siyun ti || ||
